# Proxy on the LHS

Number of combinations = 1370/1440

Bootstrap = Bayesian 

```{r, echo = FALSE}
beta1 <- read.csv(file.path(repo_dir, "04_simulation/lhs/bayesian/simulations_averaged_lhs.csv")) %>% 
  filter(coef_name!="(Intercept)") %>% # Plot only \beta_1
  mutate(model = if_else(model=="gpt-3.5-turbo-0125", "gpt-3.5", model))
```

<!-- ## Figures -->

```{r, echo=FALSE}
figures_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "figures")
dir.create(figures_dir, showWarnings=FALSE)

legend_colors <- c("Yhuman_V"="black", "Yllm_V"="#1f77b4", "train_Yhuman_V"="#008000", "test_Ytilde_V"="#ff7f0e")
legend_labels <- c("Yhuman_V"=TeX(r"($\beta_1^*$)"),
                   "Yllm_V"=TeX(r"($\hat{\beta}_1$ (LLM))"), 
                   "train_Yhuman_V"=TeX(r"($\beta_1^{train}$ (Human))"), 
                   "test_Ytilde_V"=TeX(r"($\tilde{\beta}_1$ (Debiased))"))

regression_label <- TeX(r"(LHS Regression: $1\{Y=y\} = \beta_0 + \beta_1 V$)")
```

<!-- ### Figure 1: Density Plot of $\text{Bias}(\beta_1, \beta_1^\star)$ by Training Proportion -->

```{r, fig.height=4, echo=FALSE}
# Figure 1
p1 <- ggplot(data=beta1, aes(x=bias, color=regression)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=0, color="black", linetype = "dashed") +
  # geom_histogram(alpha=0, bins = 40, position = "identity") +
  geom_density() +
  labs(title=TeX(r"(Density Plots of $Bias(\beta_1, \beta_1^*)$ by Training Proportion)"),
       subtitle=regression_label) +
  xlab(TeX(r"($Bias(\beta_1, \beta_1^*) = E[\beta_1] - \beta_1^*$)")) +
  facet_grid(train_proportion ~ ., scales="free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(name="", values=legend_colors, breaks=names(legend_colors), labels=legend_labels) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.major=element_blank(), panel.grid.minor=element_blank(), legend.position="right")
p1
```

<!-- ### Figure 2: Empirical CDF Plot of $\text{MSE}(\beta_1, \beta_1^\star)$ by Training Proportion -->

```{r, fig.height=4, echo=FALSE}
p2 <- ggplot(data=beta1, aes(x=mse, color=regression)) +
  stat_ecdf() +
  labs(title=TeX(r"(Empirical CDF of $MSE(\beta_1, \beta_1^*)$ by Training Proportion)"),
       subtitle=regression_label) +
  facet_grid(train_proportion ~ .) +
  xlab(TeX(r"($MSE(\beta_1, \beta_1^*) = E[(\beta_1 - \beta_1^*)^2]$)")) +
  scale_color_manual(name="", values=legend_colors, labels=legend_labels, breaks=names(legend_colors)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.major=element_blank(), panel.grid.minor=element_blank(), legend.position="right")
p2
```

<!-- ### Figure 3: Density Plot of $\text{Bias}(\beta_1, \beta_1^\star)$ by Model and Training Proportion  -->

```{r, fig.height=4*2, echo=FALSE}
p3 <- ggplot(data=beta1, aes(x=bias, color=regression)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=0, color="black", linetype = "dashed") +
  # geom_histogram(alpha=0, bins = 40, position = "identity") +
  geom_density() +
  labs(title=TeX(r"(Density Plots of $Bias(\beta_1, \beta_1^*)$ by Model & Training Proportion)"),
       subtitle=regression_label) +
  xlab(TeX(r"($Bias(\beta_1, \beta_1^*) = E[\beta_1] - \beta_1^*$)")) +
  facet_grid(train_proportion + model ~ ., scales="free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(name="", values=legend_colors, breaks=names(legend_colors), labels=legend_labels) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.major=element_blank(), panel.grid.minor=element_blank(), legend.position="right")
p3
```

<!-- ## Dataframes/Tables -->

```{r echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
alpha = 0.10
probs = c(alpha/2, 1-alpha/2)

df1 <- beta1 %>% 
  mutate(statistic=bias) %>%
  group_by(train_proportion, regression) %>% 
  summarise(
    "Mean" = mean(statistic), 
    "SD" = sd(statistic),
    "Median" = median(statistic),
    "5%" = quantile(statistic, probs[1]), 
    "95%" = quantile(statistic, probs[2]),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  rename(c("Train Proportion"=train_proportion, "Regression"=regression))
kbl(df1, caption="Bias Summary Statistics by Training Proportion", digits=5, booktabs=T, linesep = "") %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = "striped", stripe_index = c(1:3, 7:9))
```
